baselineCapabilities.name: 1D Lumped Fourier Conduction
baselineCapabilities.limitations: Zero spatial resolution, no 2D/3D heat spreading

baselineCapabilities.name: Newton Cooling Boundary
baselineCapabilities.scope: Lumped surface heat loss Q = h*A*(Ts - Tinf)
baselineCapabilities.limitations: Constant temperature assumption across entire boundary area

baselineCapabilities.name: Linear FEM Continuum Solver
baselineCapabilities.scope: Generic mesh steady & backward-Euler transient solve
baselineCapabilities.limitations: No native PCB stackup, no copper plane spreading, no package thermal resistance model

targetCapabilities.name: Spatial 2D/2.5D Multilayer Conductance Network Solver
targetCapabilities.discretization: Finite Volume Method / Conservation-law Conductance Matrix [K]{T} = {Q_eff}

targetCapabilities.name: PCB Multilayer Anisotropic Effective Conductivity Formulation
targetCapabilities.governingEquation: k_inplane = sum(k_i * t_i) / t_total, k_throughplane = t_total / sum(t_i / k_i)
targetCapabilities.features: Explicit copper weights (1oz, 2oz, etc.), dielectric layers (FR4, polyimide), thermal vias enhancement

targetCapabilities.name: Localized Footprint Heat Source Mapping & Boundary Integration
targetCapabilities.features: Converts component placement (x, y, w, h, P_diss) into cell-weighted volumetric heat generation without double-counting; natural convection & forced convection top/bottom/edges; fixed temperature heat sinks / chassis mounts

targetCapabilities.name: Component Package Thermal Hierarchy (Junction-Case-Board)
targetCapabilities.features: Computes T_board(x, y), T_case = T_board + P * R_theta_CS, T_junction = T_case + P * R_theta_JC
